title: Sha'ban: the run-up

segments.voice: Yesterday, the gift of prayer: a rest set into the day. This part has also given you mid-month's bright days, a new month by looking up, a fresh year, rescue and grief, and love by following. Now the month right before Ramadan.
screen: `THE GIFT OF PRAYER.` → `SIX MONTHS, BACK.` → `NOW, THE MONTH BEFORE.`

segments.voice: Marathon plans don't start with the full distance; they start with weeks of shorter runs, and the race is half-won before the start line. In a report in Sunan an-Nasa'i, Usama ibn Zayd notices the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ fasting a great deal in Sha'ban, and asks him why. His answer begins: it's a month people neglect, between Rajab and Ramadan.
screen: `SHORTER RUNS FIRST.` → `WHY SO MUCH FASTING?` → `A MONTH PEOPLE NEGLECT.`

segments.voice: The rest of his answer: it's a month in which deeds are raised to the Lord of the worlds, and he loved for his deeds to be raised while he was fasting. That's the same reason you met for Mondays and Thursdays, now stretched across a month. And Aisha, in Sahih al-Bukhari, says she never saw him fast more in any month than in Sha'ban, apart from Ramadan. There's a twist at the finish line, too. Another report in Bukhari says not to start fasting a day or two before Ramadan, unless it's a fast you already keep, like a Monday. The run-up builds, then it pauses at the line, so the big month starts fresh. So Sha'ban works as a run-up: shorter fasts, a little more reading, habits tried out before the big month arrives. Here's the thing to tell a friend tonight: the quiet month between two famous ones is the one he gave extra attention, because people forgot it. Getting ready is part of the practice, not a delay before it.
screen: `A MONTH PEOPLE FORGET.` · `DEEDS RAISED, WHILE FASTING.` · `MORE THAN ANY MONTH BUT ONE.` · `THE RUN-UP.` · then, large: `GETTING READY.`

segments.voice: Make a Ramadan plan in three lines. The wish: one thing you'd like that month to hold, a fast, a reading, a kindness. The obstacle: what usually gets in the way. The plan: one small step you could start in Sha'ban, so the month doesn't arrive cold.
Sha'ban: the month before Ramadan, a run-up the Prophet filled with fasting, a month when deeds are raised.
Remember it this way: getting ready is part of the month itself. Seven of fourteen, and Ramadan is next.

screen: `DAY 1694 COUNTS.` → `THE MONTHLY AND YEARLY RHYTHM · 7 OF 14.` → `TOMORROW: THE WHOLE QUR'AN IN A MONTH. HOW DO YOU SPLIT IT?`

howItsDone: In Sha'ban some Muslims add voluntary fasts, catch up on missed Ramadan days, and start reading more Qur'an, so that Ramadan's habits are already under way when the month begins.
